tasks.title: Implement Core Protocol Processor Middleware
tasks.description: Build the central enforcement engine that orchestrates the Universal Execution Protocol flow
tasks.details: Create ProtocolProcessor class with TypeScript, implement middleware pattern for extensibility, support both agent and human requesters, use dependency injection for adapters
tasks.testStrategy: Unit test protocol flow with mocked adapters, validate orchestration and error handling

tasks.title: Build Validation Engine
tasks.description: Develop compliance checker that enforces protocol requirements and fallback logic
tasks.details: Implement ValidationEngine with Zod schemas, encode fallback logic per validation matrix, integrate with ProtocolProcessor, add audit logging
tasks.testStrategy: Unit test all validation scenarios including fallbacks and failure cases

tasks.title: Integrate Redis Memory Manager
tasks.description: Extend existing working memory system for UEP persistent memory
tasks.details: Enhance existing Redis integration, implement relevance scoring, add UEP-specific key schemas, ensure secure access
tasks.testStrategy: Integration tests for memory storage, retrieval, and relevance scoring

tasks.title: Create TaskMaster Adapter
tasks.description: Build adapter to automate task breakdown via TaskMaster for all incoming tasks
tasks.details: Implement TaskMasterAdapter using child_process to call taskmaster CLI, parse outputs, cache results, handle errors gracefully
tasks.testStrategy: Mock TaskMaster CLI and test adapter for correct breakdown and caching

tasks.title: Develop Context7 Scanner Adapter
tasks.description: Create adapter for automatic codebase awareness before task execution
tasks.details: Implement Context7Adapter to scan repository, identify relevant code blocks, detect collision risks, cache scan results
tasks.testStrategy: Test codebase scanning accuracy and performance with various project structures

tasks.title: Build RAG Integration Adapter
tasks.description: Implement document retrieval system using existing Upstash vector store
tasks.details: Create RAGAdapter that searches vector store for task-relevant docs, rank results by relevance, handle missing documentation gracefully
tasks.testStrategy: Test document retrieval accuracy and relevance ranking

tasks.title: Implement Protocol Logic Layer
tasks.description: Create universal reasoning patterns: Clarify → Research → Plan → Execute → Review → Report
tasks.details: Build ReasoningProtocol class, implement customizable patterns per agent, add task requirement validation (goal, metrics, fallbacks)
tasks.testStrategy: Validate reasoning pattern enforcement and customization

tasks.title: Create CLI Wrapper for Human Prompts
tasks.description: Build command-line interface for human prompt enhancement
tasks.details: Create uep CLI tool, implement prompt interception, integrate with existing Claude Code workflow, add debug mode
tasks.testStrategy: Test human prompt enhancement and debug capabilities

tasks.title: Integrate with Meta-Agent Factory
tasks.description: Update existing meta-agents to use UEP middleware
tasks.details: Modify PRD Parser, Scaffold Generator, and other agents to route through UEP, update start-all-agents.js, maintain backward compatibility
tasks.testStrategy: Integration tests with existing agent workflows

tasks.title: Build Execution Trace System
tasks.description: Implement comprehensive logging and monitoring for UEP decisions
tasks.details: Create ExecutionTracer, log all protocol decisions, implement audit trails, add performance metrics
tasks.testStrategy: Validate trace completeness and performance monitoring
